A ~3.15 kb deletion spanning intron 4 through the 3' UTR. Should be directly visible as a large gap/soft-clip in a single ONT read spanning the combined 6.7 kb amplicon, PROVIDED the Wu 3'UTR reverse primer sits downstream of cDNA position *3252. Recommend validating with a known ABO*O.16 reference sample once available; until then this allele will silently type as apparent homozygosity for whatever remains on the other allele (a false-homozygote risk worth flagging in your validation plan).

TRUE ASSAY GAP: exon 1 sits upstream of the Goebel intron-1 forward primer and is not expected to be captured by the combined exon2-7 amplicon. Confirm the exact primer coordinate before ruling this out entirely; if genuinely outside the amplicon, capturing these two start-codon variants requires a new forward primer further upstream (exon 1 / promoter region), not a software change.
